# Licence of the vendored W3C SPARQL 1.1 test-suite subset

Every file in this directory except this one and `PROVENANCE.md` is an
unmodified copy from the W3C SPARQL 1.1 test suite in
[w3c/rdf-tests](https://github.com/w3c/rdf-tests) (`sparql/sparql11`, commit
`369a90d1a60c021b746df2e411da0ff36258a758`). Only some sections of the suite
are copied (see `PROVENANCE.md`). These files are third-party material:
Open Triplestore's AGPL-3.0 + Commons Clause licence does not apply to them.

The root `LICENSE.md` of w3c/rdf-tests at that commit, reproduced unchanged

## Licence this subset is redistributed under

W3C lets the licensee choose, for each use, between the W3C Test Suite
License and the W3C 3-clause BSD License. This subset is redistributed under
the **W3C 3-clause BSD License** only. W3C's test-suite licence policy treats
a subset of a test suite as a derivative work, and the W3C Test Suite License
grants no right to create derivatives, so that licence cannot cover this copy.

This project uses these tests only for development and bug tracking, the uses
the W3C 3-clause BSD License is offered for. A subset of a W3C test suite does
not allow claims of performance or the use of the name W3C
(https://www.w3.org/copyright/test-suites-licenses/), so no pass count, pass
rate or conformance claim is published for them; `docs/conformance/sparql11.md`
describes the run and tracks its known failures.

The licence text follows, verbatim from
<https://www.w3.org/copyright/3-clause-bsd-license-2008/> (plain-text copy:
[`LICENSES/W3C-BSD-3-Clause-2008.txt`](../../../LICENSES/W3C-BSD-3-Clause-2008.txt)).
